title: Lagrange realism R5: ropes, honest plumes, impingement, array flex, particles
body:
Phase R5 of docs/research/unreal/2026-09-27-lagrange-realism-audit.md.

- E1 ribbon/tube meshes; E2 stateless seeded particles (closed-form from seed and tick) so replays reproduce effects.
- E3 cold-gas plume visuals gated by sunlight.
- E4 deterministic XPBD tether rope in crates/physics, pinned to the rigid tether joint and limited from both ends.
- E5 free-molecular plume impingement forces with an `impingement` ledger term.
- E6 modal flex of solar arrays.
- E7 fireflies and ice flakes under solar radiation pressure.

**Accept:** slack tether curves and whips; firing near a free part moves it and the ledger balances; arrays ring down after a burn; journal replay reproduces rope shapes and particles.
